sourceFindings.finding: Current shared validation requires parameter zero when effect is CMD_NONE. NativeSong::validate calls NativeNoteEffectSupported; this input is invalid in the current model, and Windows recovers by dropping the incompatible event with a warning/source protection. A different encoder condition alone is not a reachable valid-edit loss defect.

The actual vector removes duration from a PitchSlide (kind 3). Windows diagnoses the missing field; Mac defaults to zero then rejects the invalid slide. Recorded native observations on both hosts drop that incompatible entry with a warning and source protection. Other optional-field default policy still belongs to P6; this vector does not demonstrate a valid-edit loss.
